title: Stealth bomber over Altadena on New Year's Day

tellings.quote: Uh and other examples I use like um seeing the stealth bomber fly over my house when I lived in Aladena.

plain: The researcher and skeptic Michael Shermer says he once saw a stealth bomber fly over his house when he lived in Altadena, California, on New Year's Day. He tells Michels this as one of the examples he uses of an unusual but explainable thing in the sky, the kind of sight that could be taken for a UFO by someone who did not know what it was.
